Sizing summary (workshop outcomes, numbers are REDWOOD-style draft):
- Workload profile: realtime chat (multiturn), support assistant backfill, embeddings for search and reranking.
- Baseline steady-state requests: ~60 QPS (median working hours), average request size ~350 input tokens, expected output ~120 tokens.
- Baseline token/sec estimate: ~7,500 tokens/sec (aggregate, steady).
- Daily peak (business spikes, promotions): up to 250 QPS sustained for short windows (5-20 minutes), occasional bursts to ~350 QPS (couple times/day).
- Throughput goal: guaranteed 150 QPS sustained for production tier; burst to 300 QPS with autoscale/fallback policy.
- Latency targets: p50 < 50ms, p95 < 200ms for responses <= 512 tokens. For >512 tokens need separate SLO (p95 < 400ms).
- Model choices: default r3-13B quantized for cost/latency tradeoff; r3-70B (float16) as regional fallback for quality-critical flows.

Reserved GPU planning (workshop recommendation):
- Baseline reservation: 8x H100-80GB equiv nodes (sized for sustained 150 QPS with batching + KV cache).
- Burst/peak capacity: autoscale pool up to 16x H100 for 300 QPS sustained windows. Short-lived bursts handled via routing to Hosted spare capacity or lower-cost quantized variants.
- Batching policy: continuous batching target 16-32 tokens/request window for chat; dynamic per-latency SLA.
- Caching: strong prefix/KV caching for multi-turn sessions expected to cut token throughput by 20-35% on steady traffic.
- Quantization & perf knobs: 8-bit quantization for r3-13B; mixed precision for r3-70B fallback. SE to provide kernel tuning recommendations post-PoC.

SLA & commercial negotiation points (customer priorities):
- Firm throughput guarantees for reserved pool (150 QPS sustained) with clear credit formula on under-delivery.
- Maintenance windows: prefer 2x/week short windows; Redwood proposed staggered host-level maintenance with 99.95% uptime target.
- Data residency: production traffic must terminate in us-east-1 and be restricted to VPC subnets.
- Security controls: SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, KMS integration for key rotation, per-request audit logging with 90-day retention (customer exploring 365-day option).
- Pricing: willing to commit 12-month ARR for discount; evaluating TCO vs self-hosting H100 cluster.
